name: @egnyte/agentic-cli
description: Egnyte CLI designed for AI agent consumption — zero runtime dependencies, agent-first design
author: egnyte

scripts.lint: node --check src/index.js src/lib/*.js src/commands/*.js && echo OK
scripts.release: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && npm view @egnyte/agentic-cli@$VERSION version --registry https://nexus3.egnyte-internal.com/repository/integrations-nexus/ 2>/dev/null && echo "Version $VERSION already published, skipping." || npm publish
